title: Docker or Podman: Container Engines Compared
excerpt: Docker made containers mainstream; Podman offers a daemonless, rootless-first alternative with largely compatible commands. The choice comes down to ecosystem familiarity versus security defaults.
verdict: Docker remains the most widely used and best-documented option. Podman is a strong alternative when running containers without root privileges and without a central daemon matters to you, and its Docker-compatible commands make switching straightforward.
